scripts.migration:generate: npm run build && typeorm migration:generate ./src/migrations/$npm_config_name -d dist/data-source.js && node ../../scripts/fix-migration-imports.mjs
scripts.migration:run: npm run build && typeorm migration:run -d dist/data-source.js
scripts.migration:revert: npm run build && typeorm migration:revert -d dist/data-source.js
